name: js-diff
instruction: Implement diffLines.js (CommonJS): module.exports = diffLines. diffLines(a, b) splits both strings on '\n' and returns a MINIMAL line diff as an array of { type, line } objects, where type is 'eq', 'del' (present in a only) or 'add' (present in b only). Minimal means it is based on a longest common subsequence: the number of del+add entries must be as small as possible. When a deletion and an insertion are equally good at some position, emit the DELETION first, so the output is deterministic. An empty string counts as zero lines, not one.
